title: P2753 - P2753
symptoms: Stalling, no-start, no communication to Kontrol Modülü(s)
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri or power supply to/from N82, N509, or N488 faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  N82, N509, or N488
Kontrol edin:  for applicable recalls or TPIs related to N82 failure resulting in coolant migration thorough the N82 solenoid connector resting in destroyed wiring harness(es)
technicalNotes:
This page contains a photo from a CHHB 2.0T Mk7 Golf after N82 and harness failure: P1888
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: any number of 2011-2013 model year vehicles make sure to Kontrol edin: for open recalls and TPIs for noted issues.  These are just a few documents that were published:
NAR (North American Region) Audi A8 2011-2013 model years
Recall Service Action Code: 80B8
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2016/MC-10128034-9999.pdf
NAR (North American Region) Various models 2011-2014 model years
TPI 2033806 suggests checking/replacing N82, N509, or N488 as needed in addition to any damaged harnesses.
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2019/MC-10155655-9999.pdf  NHTSA
RoW (Rest of World) Audi A8 4.2L and 6.3L FSI
Recall Service campaign 80B8 (2042850)
RoW (Rest of World) A6 2.0TFSI
Service campaign 80B6 (2037311)
RoW (Rest of World) includes the A4 Saloon and Avant, A5 and Cabriolet, A6, A7, A8 and Q7
TPI 2033325/2 suggests checking/replacing N82, N509, or N488 as needed in addition to any damaged harnesses.
